title: Security incident response
explain: Triage, forensics evidence, customer comms, root cause, prevention controls. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Security incident response" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Security incident response, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Security incident response without a failure story
howToApply: Use Security incident response explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Security incident response” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Security → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Security incident response” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Security incident response” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Security incident response”.
